capabilities.text: Type or paste the data as a list of values, one dot per value with equal values stacked
Give the data as a frequency table: each value once with how many of it there are
capabilities.note: the data box takes a list of values only

capabilities.text: Use fractions and mixed numbers such as 3/4 and 1 1/2 as values, with the number line numbered in fractions
capabilities.note: data::numbers reads decimals only; 3/4 and 1 1/2 are skipped as words

capabilities.text: Give students a blank number line to plot the data on
capabilities.note: the reference leaves the data empty; ours keeps the data and the student copy (Show answers off) hides the dots and marks, keeping the number line. Empty data shows 'Enter some data' instead of a number line; evidence cleared at round-0 review (owner: strict, credit only a full match): was changes:show_answers=false

capabilities.text: Draw X's instead of dots as the marks
Write an axis title under the number line
Put a blank line in place of the chart or axis title for students
capabilities.note: titles are text only; no blank-line mode
turning the automatic line off is part of typing a range
4 to 13 is the automatic line for the opening data, so only the step differs

capabilities.text: Have the number line's range and count-by worked out from the data
capabilities.note: the opening already has data, so the render differs because the data changes; the checker confirms the axis is re-fitted

capabilities.text: Choose which ticks are numbered (every tick, every 2nd, 4th, 5th or 10th, or none)
Finish an end of the number line with an arrow
capabilities.note: the line has plain ends; the two ends are set separately on the reference

capabilities.text: Finish an end of the number line with a circle
